messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty triggered for SableCorp VPC — high severity. Possible PII in dedicated pool debug logs. Incident link: <https://pagerduty.example/incident/INC-8241|INC-8241>
Alice Chen: I'm oncall, picking this up. Starting triage. Whoever has customer context ping me.
Maya Singh: Jordan from Sable is in the thread — they saw names/emails make it into their SIEM via our forwarder.
Jordan (Sable Support): Confirmed. Our SIEM received raw request bodies from /redact-aggregator. We need immediate redaction + assurance.
Raj Patel: quick clarifying q: was this trace-level logging from model servers or from an ingestion pipeline?
Alice Chen: looks like request-level debug logs from dedicated pool `sable-prod-pool-1` — deploy last night enabled `LOG_REQUESTS=debug` for 3h.
Sam (Infra Sec): risk assessment: PII exposure across tenant isolation? Any other tenants affected?
Alice Chen: isolation holds. Only Sable tenant's pool shows the debug flag. No cross-tenant blob detected.
Jules (Legal): do not delete raw artifacts yet. We need chain-of-custody and to follow legal hold procedure. We can provide redacted exports while we review.
Maya Singh: I'll coordinate comms. Jordan — customer wants sanitized logs + timeline and confirmation raw copies won't be shared.
Jordan (Sable Support): Correct. They need sanitized artifacts and a statement we will reduce retention and delete any external copies.
Alice Chen: proposed immediate mitigations: 1) enable live redaction sidecar on the pool 2) revoke log forwarders to external SIEMs 3) reprocess recent logs into a redacted archive 4) rotate any temporary keys used by forwarders.
Alice Chen: command to toggle sidecar (run by infra):
```
# enable redaction sidecar on pool
rctrl service update sable-prod-pool-1 --env REDACTIVE=on --filter-sidecar=redact-v2
```
Raj Patel: deploying sidecar now — expect ~2-3min warmup. Also kicking off reprocess to create redacted archive for last 24h.
Alice Chen: starting reprocess job: job id `0x7a9f`
```
reproc start --pool sable-prod-pool-1 --from -24h --filter redact-v2 --out s3://internal-artifacts/sable/1769800000/redacted.tar.gz
```
Sam (Infra Sec): rotating forwarder secrets and revoking external endpoints now:
```
aws secretsmanager rotate --name /sable/log-forwarder
# remove external destinations
rctrl forwarder disable --name sable-external-forwarder
```
Jules (Legal): I'm opening a legal ticket for a temporary redaction exception. We need SRE + CS sign-off and a customer-signed exception form before lifting the hold. I'll attach sample redaction proof requirements.
Maya Singh: Jordan — can you confirm whether the customer requires raw logs for any investigation?
Jordan (Sable Support): They only want sanitized logs. They request a certificate of deletion for raw copies and a retention change to 30 days.
Alice Chen: status update: sidecar deploy in progress (Raj), reprocess job `0x7a9f` running, forwarder creds rotating (Sam), legal ticket created (Jules). Severity bumped to P2 while we finish mitigation. Handing initial triage to @Alex for follow-up after warmup.
Incident Bot: Handoff scheduled to Alex at 12:45 UTC — oncall takeover.
Alex (oncall): ack, I'll take over after the sidecar warmup. Please post the reprocess artifact and sample redacted lines when ready.
Raj Patel: sidecar deployed and warmed. CPU delta +6%, no observable service degradation. Forwarders successfully disabled.
Alice Chen: reprocess completed — artifact uploaded to internal S3 path: `s3://internal-artifacts/sable/1769800000/redacted.tar.gz`. Sample redacted lines below: 
```
[REDACTED] user_email:[REDACTED] request_id:abc123 action:generate model:m5
[REDACTED] user_name:[REDACTED] prompt_hash:5f4d3a ...
```
Jules (Legal): reviewing samples. Need a signed redaction exception doc (customer + SRE lead) before we mark raw copies for deletion. I'll draft and share within the ticket.
Maya Singh: customer reviewed sample and approved redaction pattern. Jordan — they will sign once doc is shared.
Jordan (Sable Support): Customer signed at 12:58 UTC. They also requested we shorten retention to 30 days and confirm deletion of any external backups.
Alice Chen: applied retention change to tenant raw logs: 
```
rctrl retention set --tenant sable --days 30 --raw-keep false
```
Sam (Infra Sec): forwarder creds rotated and external endpoints removed. Verified no external pullers active.
Jules (Legal): legal hold for review is satisfied for the exception workflow. I will close the legal ticket once we provide deletion attestation for the raw copies and the signed exception doc.
Alex (oncall): taking the final validation and follow-ups: - attach signed doc to incident - confirm deletion attestation for raw copies - schedule postmortem to update runbook and deploy checks. Assigning tasks in the incident tracker.
Maya Singh: thanks team. Customer-facing note prepared and sent: summary of actions + redacted artifact link + promise of deletion attestation.
Alice Chen: lessons learned: avoid enabling debug-level request logging on production pools without cross-team signoff; add a runbook step to require legal/CS sign-off for extended raw retention.
Alice Chen: closing initial thread and moving to postmortem tracking in #postmortems. :white_check_mark:
